title: Consolidate the manifest/binding resolution rule into one helper
description: The rule that a checkout manifest project and vault binding must agree — project_not_registered when either is missing, binding_conflict when they differ — now exists as four private copies: boundProjectId in application/run.ts, boundProject in application/secrets.ts, the same checks twice in application/profiles.ts, and boundProject in application/audit.ts (added by WCLI-11). Each is identical in effect, so a change to the rule has four places to land and three chances to be missed. WCLI-11 declined to consolidate inside its own change because that would touch the run path a reviewer must re-verify, and filed this instead. One site is not the same call: profiles.ts also re-checks the binding inside a mutation transaction against an already-resolved projectId rather than against the manifest, so it needs its own reading before it moves.

acceptanceCriteria.text: One exported helper states the rule and its two error codes, and run.ts, secrets.ts, profiles.ts and audit.ts call it with no private copy left behind.
The consolidation is behaviour-preserving: the existing tests that assert project_not_registered and binding_conflict stay green, and each call site is read back from those tests rather than assumed.

plan: One module, src/application/binding.ts: the rule stated once, with `ward check` (unbound reported) and the write-transaction re-check (expected id already resolved) as named readings rather than separate copies.
Replace the rule-1 copies: run.ts boundProjectId, secrets.ts boundProject, audit.ts boundProject, profiles.ts manifestOf/authorityFor/requireBound.
Replace the rule-2 copies with the shared re-check: run.ts writeAudit, secrets.ts boundProjectOf, profiles.ts writeApproval.

Behaviour-preserving evidence: each call site read back from a test - the existing project_not_registered/binding_conflict cases stay green, and new cases cover the sites no test reached (run.ts both sites, profiles.ts conflict and its transaction re-check).
Gate: bun run check green; PR with the call-site-to-test mapping; independent review per spec 15; squash merge; then promote dev to main.
implementationNotes:
DELIVERED IN PR opum-ai/ward-cli#78; the required contexts are green on the commit this note cites — run 36538213142 (Check, Docs, Tracker integrity, attempt 1, success) on e58c32f8b888d330a31ab6df0debd0f48782b489, the review-fix commit, which carries the whole deliverable. The closing commit is tracker-only; the merge rides the final head's contexts, checked separately before the squash.

WHAT LANDED. src/application/binding.ts states the rule once: a private bindingNaming (the conflict check, both error codes) and three readings — boundProject (refusing; run.ts, secrets.ts, audit.ts, profiles.ts's approve/revoke), requireBinding (against a project id an earlier read resolved; every write transaction), bindingAuthority (the readiness reading: `ward check` and `ward profile list`). requireManifest replaced the manifest-gone refusals. Deleted: run.ts boundProjectId; secrets.ts boundProject and boundProjectOf; audit.ts boundProject; profiles.ts manifestOf, authorityFor and requireBound. project.ts (registration rule) and reporting.ts (report-value readings) were read and deliberately left: different rules, different inputs.

AC1 EVIDENCE. The two codes are thrown only in binding.ts and project.ts; findBinding call sites are binding.ts, project.ts and reporting.ts.

AC2 EVIDENCE. Two deliberate mutations of the helper, red sets predicted before each run: removing the conflict check reddens exactly the 7 binding_conflict cases (run x2, secret x2, profile x2, audit x1) with project.ts's 2 registration cases green; removing the missing-binding refusal reddens exactly the 7 not-registered cases. Eight new cases (run x5, profile x3) cover the sites no existing test reached.

REVIEW (spec 15, opum-workflow reviewer grounded on the lore review pack): clean-with-findings, no behaviour defect, both findings fixed in e58c32f. F1: the no-manifest case as first written pinned neither state its title named — deleting requireManifest at run.ts:97 left 623/623 green; it now exercises no-vault and key-missing, and the removal reddens it (expected 4 project_not_registered, received 3 vault_not_found), while the keyless half would answer vault_key_missing with one credential-store read. F2: the module now names the readiness reading as both commands. Reviewer limits named: the review pack does not carry WARD_MVP_AGENT_SPEC.md; no packaged-binary smoke run; its mutation forms were its own (counts matched exactly).

GATE. bun run check on e58c32f: typecheck, lint (2 pre-existing test-file warnings), format, layer check 46 files 0 violations, 623 tests across 23 files, bun 1.3.14.
finalSummary: Consolidated the manifest/binding resolution rule into src/application/binding.ts, where both error codes are now raised once: boundProject, requireBinding, bindingAuthority and requireManifest replaced the private copies in run.ts, secrets.ts, profiles.ts and audit.ts (nine functions deleted), and every write transaction's re-check reads from the same statement. Behaviour preservation is evidenced per call site by two helper mutations whose predicted red sets matched exactly (7 binding_conflict cases; 7 not-registered cases) plus 8 new cases for the sites no test reached; the independent review's F1 then showed the no-manifest case pinned neither of its two states, and it was rewritten so removing the early check reddens it. Verified on e58c32f: bun run check green (623 tests, 23 files; layer check 46 files 0 violations) and required contexts Check, Docs, Tracker integrity green (run 36538213142). Review: clean-with-findings, no behaviour defect; F1 and F2 fixed before landing.
